===Playoffs===
{{ShowBracket|id=8KA8E8MV2G}}

==Format==
*'''Group Stage''':
** Four groups of four teams
** Single Round Robin, All matches are played in a {{Abbr/Bo2}}: 
*** Winning 2-0 grants 3 points
*** Drawing 1-1 grants 1 point
*** Losing 0-2 grants 0 points
*'''Playoffs''':
** Single Elimination
** All matches are played in a {{Abbr/Bo5}}
